sourceEvidence.paraphrase: The extraction defines Talents, Skills, and Knowledges and says exact Ability catalog generation comes from dedicated source sections.
Abilities start at 0, use Primary/Secondary/Tertiary priorities, and allocate 13/9/5 points.
Lupus initial Ability allocation is restricted for Crafts, Drive, Etiquette, Firearms, Computer, Law, Linguistics, Politics, and Science; freebie applicability remains unresolved.
The vertical slice includes Ability allocation as step 3, validates 13/9/5, and treats Ability above 3 during base allocation plus Lupus restricted allocation as invalid fixtures.

The original source supports Ability categories/order, places Leadership/Lideran?a under Skills/Per?cias, lists Lupus base restricted Abilities, and supports later trained acquisition with bonus points or experience.
